explanation: The theorem computes the inverse of one specific 3x3 block matrix !![0,u,0;-u,0,0;0,0,w] in GL (Fin 3) F. Mathlib has generic tools such as Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv, Matrix.coe_units_inv and Units.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right. It also has inverse formulas for diagonal matrices and 2x2 matrices. None of these gives this explicit block inverse. Any derivation would still need the explicit product check, which the proof does with fin_cases and simp. That is an auxiliary fact of some substance, so this is not a one- or two-line special case. I did not run a grep of Mathlib for this exact matrix shape. This verdict rests on my knowledge of those general lemmas and on the form of the proof.
